verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an AI coding workbench, but the pack documents none: no retention settings, deletion commands, or retention policy. The closest items fall short. `ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR` only sets where local data is written, and the installer note says only that existing session data is not migrated or deleted. Community reports of unconsented cloud uploads of repository and workspace snapshots, which some users could not reproduce, point away from user control rather than toward it.
